# netbox_aggregate (Data Source)

An aggregate (ipam.aggregate): a top-level block a RIR allocated.

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/features/ipam/#aggregates):

> NetBox allows us to specify the portions of IP space that are interesting to us by defining aggregates. Typically, an aggregate will correspond to either an allocation of public (globally routable) IP space granted by a regional authority, or a private (internally-routable) designation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_aggregate" "test" {
  id = 123
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `custom_field_filters` (Map of String) Custom field values to match, by field name, e.g. { tier = "gold" }: each entry filters as cf_<field name> with the field's own filter logic, loose (case-insensitive substring) or exact.
- `description` (String)
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `prefix` (String) The aggregate in CIDR notation, e.g. 10.0.0.0/8.
- `rir_id` (Number) Id of the RIR that allocated the aggregate.
- `tag_slug` (String) Slug of a tag the object carries.
- `tenant_id` (Number) Id of the tenant.

### Read-Only

- `comments` (String)
- `created` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `date_added` (String) Date the aggregate was added, as YYYY-MM-DD. Keeps its value when removed from the configuration.
- `family` (Number) Address family: 4 or 6.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `url` (String)
